raised.reason: T073.md asserts that pre-paper authorization binds to the current T109 manifest/report/simulation-evidence checksums and that T109 is the registry-bound current evidence source. After T112 is APPROVED, T109 is the documented predecessor with cursor-fabricated partition refs, block_as_tick evidence and zero-fill run facts; trusting T109 as current in T073 would let the pre-paper authorization refer to defective evidence. A reader of T073's contract that relies on the unchanged language would be misled into treating the defective T109 evidence as the current basis for authorization.
raised.required_disposition: CONTRACT: deliverables, acceptance, must-not and references retarget current-evidence language from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence (paired-version checksums); T109 is preserved only as historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment; no Must-not, safety, execution or signer clause is weakened. DEPENDENCY: T112 added to T073 depends_on (`T025, T027, T107, T109, T112`). IMPLEMENTATION: not applicable in this amendment; the pre-paper Web entry point will consume T112 evidence when the contract is later executed. DATA: existing T109 / T105 / T069 / T063 artifacts and prior pre-paper authorizations stay byte-identical and read-only. OPERATIONS: not applicable in this amendment; runtime cutover remains gated by T112 and the SUPERSEDE amendment. SECURITY: not applicable; the entry-point credential boundary is unchanged and T112 evidence carries no secrets. VERIFICATION: existing acceptance clauses remain plus T112-version rendering, pre-T112-legacy rendering, fail-closed current-evidence cases, no-republication, replay-does-not-approve and credential-refusal tests; the P07 README inspection test still names the same entry point.
